text_en: Observe the month of Abib by keeping the passover to the Lord your God, for in the month of Abib the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
text_cn: 你应遵守“阿彼布”月，为上主你的天主举行逾越节，因为在“阿彼布”月的一个夜里，上主你的天主领你出了埃及。

text_en: You shall offer the passover sacrifice to the Lord your God, from the flock and the herd, at the place that the Lord will choose as a dwelling for his name.
text_cn: 你应在上主所选定立自己名号的地方，给上主你的天主祭杀牛羊，作为逾越节牺牲。

text_en: You must not eat with it anything leavened. For seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it—the bread of affliction—because you came out of the land of Egypt in great haste, so that all the days of your life you may remember the day of your departure from the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 吃这祭肉时，不可吃发酵饼；七天之内，当吃无酵饼，即困苦饼，因为你曾仓猝地走出了埃及地。为此你一生应天天记念你出埃及的日子。

text_en: No leaven shall be seen with you in all your territory for seven days; and none of the meat of what you slaughter on the evening of the first day shall remain until morning.
text_cn: 七天之久，在你全境内不许见到酵母；你前一天晚上祭献的牲肉，不可有剩下的，留到早晨。

text_en: You are not permitted to offer the passover sacrifice within any of your towns that the Lord your God is giving you.
text_cn: 你不可在上主你的天主赐给你的任何城镇内，祭杀逾越节牺牲；

text_en: But at the place that the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his name, only there shall you offer the passover sacrifice, in the evening at sunset, the time of day when you departed from Egypt.
text_cn: 只可在上主你的天主所选定立自己名号的地方，晚上太阳快落时，就是你出埃及的时刻，祭杀逾越节牺牲。

text_en: You shall cook it and eat it at the place that the Lord your God will choose; the next morning you may go back to your tents.
text_cn: 并应在上主你的天主所选定的地方，将祭牲煮熟分食；到了早晨，你可回到你的帐棚中去。

text_en: For six days you shall continue to eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a solemn assembly for the Lord your God, when you shall do no work.
text_cn: 六天内应吃无酵饼，到第七天，应为上主你的天主召开盛会，任何劳工都不许做。

text_en: You shall count seven weeks; begin to count the seven weeks from the time the sickle is first put to the standing grain.
text_cn: 你应数七个星期，从镰刀收割庄稼算起，数七个星期，

text_en: Then you shall keep the festival of weeks to the Lord your God, contributing a freewill offering in proportion to the blessing that you have received from the Lord your God.
text_cn: 为上主你的天主举行七七节，照上主你的天主祝福你的，献上你手中自愿献的祭品。

text_en: Rejoice before the Lord your God—you and your sons and your daughters, your male and female slaves, the Levites resident in your towns, as well as the strangers, the orphans, and the widows who are among you—at the place that the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his name.
text_cn: 你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及在你城镇内的肋未人，在你中间的外方人、孤儿和寡妇，都应在上主你的天主所选定立自己名号的地方，于上主你的天主面前欢乐。

text_en: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and diligently observe these statutes.
text_cn: 应记得你在埃及也曾做过奴隶，所以应谨守遵行这些法令。

text_en: You shall keep the festival of booths for seven days, when you have gathered in the produce from your threshing floor and your wine press.
text_cn: 你由禾场和榨酒池内收藏了出产以后，应七天举行帐棚节。

text_en: Rejoice during your festival, you and your sons and your daughters, your male and female slaves, as well as the Levites, the strangers, the orphans, and the widows resident in your towns.
text_cn: 在这庆节内，你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及在你城镇内的肋未人、外方人、孤儿和寡妇都应欢乐。

text_en: Seven days you shall keep the festival to the Lord your God at the place that the Lord will choose; for the Lord your God will bless you in all your produce and in all your undertakings, and you shall surely celebrate.
text_cn: 你应在上主所选定的地方，为上主你的天主举行这庆节七天，因为上主你的天主，要在你的一切收获和你着手进行的一切事业上祝福你，使你满心喜乐。

text_en: Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord your God at the place that he will choose: at the festival of unleavened bread, at the festival of weeks, and at the festival of booths. They shall not appear before the Lord empty-handed;
text_cn: 每年三次，即在无酵节、七七节和帐棚节，你所有的男子都应到上主所选的地方去，朝拜上主你的天主；但不要空手出现在上主面前，

text_en: all shall give as they are able, according to the blessing of the Lord your God that he has given you.
text_cn: 每人应照上主你的天主赐与你的，依自己的财力，奉献礼品。

text_en: You shall appoint judges and officials throughout your tribes, in all your towns that the Lord your God is giving you, and they shall render just decisions for the people.
text_cn: 在上主你的天主赐给你的各城镇内，要为各支派设立判官和书记，他们应按照公道审判人民，

text_en: You must not distort justice; you must not show partiality; and you must not accept bribes, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and subverts the cause of those who are in the right.
text_cn: 不可违犯公平，不可徇情顾面，不可接受贿赂，因为贿赂令智慧人的眼目失明；

text_en: Justice, and only justice, you shall pursue, so that you may live and occupy the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
text_cn: 只应追求公道与正义，好叫你能生存，占有上主你的天主赐给你的土地。

text_en: You shall not plant any tree as a sacred pole beside the altar that you make for the Lord your God;
text_cn: 在你为上主你的天主所建的祭坛旁，不许竖立任何木头的神柱；

text_en: nor shall you set up a stone pillar—things that the Lord your God hates.
text_cn: 也不可立置上主你的天主所憎恶的石碣（jié）。
